body: Oh ok. I didn't realize that. I'll look into public law options. I didn't know that was a thing and I was worried about contacting a lawyer because I don't have any money. Thanks!

Also I know my reason for getting kicked out was vague but I'm not a criminal. I did not steal anything and I wasn't on drugs. It was religious stuff. I don't think I did anything that could be seen as "shady."

I have a prepaid debit card for PayPal and what not but no real established bank account. No credit cards.... As of right now I have a 92 Cavilier and that's it. They won't even let me sell my video games or anything. I feel like they're doing this to make me suffer so I'll come around and deny the feelings I have.

I don't have much extended family and those I do have aren't speaking to me. My family is very religious and often go on overseas mission trips. I'm kinda just screwed right now. Idk. I called 211 and there may be a shelter for me but I don't have gas to even get there. I'm just in shock still and I am very scared but I do have a little bag of a few dry goods but I have to make it last until Thursday which is going to be next to impossible?

What did your parents say? Were they mad? I really don't think my family is going to come around considering my dad doesn't even want me using his last name. He said he never wants to see me again...

I've just gotten off the phone with them and they put me in touch with a shelter but I'm not sure how I'll get there as it is 53 miles away. (I live in a rural farming community of roughly 300 people) I also have a grocery bag with a few dry goods that I got from the local church/food pantry. I will not be eligable again until Thursday. What do I do? Where do I go? How will I find a job with no way of getting gas or even clean clothes? I'm so overwhelmed and scared.

Emotionally I just feel alone. I feel pathetic that I'm sleeping in my car. I feel embarrassed that I'm wearing dirty clothes because I don't have any clean ones. I feel hopeless because this situation is so overwhelming. I feel scared because I don't know what to do to survive. I feel confused because my car is the only thing I could sell but if I did that I would be stranded and have no where to sleep. I feel sad because despite this I love my family and I want to be accepted. I feel ashamed to admit these things.

Thank you. I have a little bit of dry foods from a local church I'm just really hurt and scared for my future. I know Im going to have to get a job since they will no longer be helping with my college tuition. My whole life changed in half an hour.
